'''House Demici'''<ref name="FH" /> was one of the six [[Great Houses/Legends|Great Houses of Serenno]]. [[Loranda]] and [[Hetton]] were related to House Demici. The crest of the house was a simple five-point star over a solid background.

During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], a [[Unidentified House Demici heir|heir]] of House Demici set out to hunt [[split-tail dorsallope]] with a dozen of [[Noble Guard|House Demici Noble Guard]] and went missing near the [[House Nalju/Legends|House Nalju]] territory. His father, [[Count of Serenno/Legends|Count]] [[Unidentified House Demici count|Demici]], suspected the rival House Nalju, for his son's disappearance.<ref name="FH" />
